title: Arthur C. Clarke says NASA found large life on Mars, with Buzz Aldrin present

tellings.quote:
what's really shocking and exciting to
me is that uh NASA has basically
discovered large forms of life on Mars.

plain: The science fiction writer Arthur C. Clarke said around 2000, in Sri Lanka and with Buzz Aldrin present, that NASA had basically discovered large forms of life on Mars, and that this was what shocked and excited him most. The researcher Maaneli Derakhshani relays Clarke's words to Michels; if true, it would mean NASA knew of life beyond Earth and kept it quiet.
